svg.title: Proved throw margin across blue's arm (1,−)
svg.desc: 456 proved cells tile 2 to 16.5 degrees; each cell's lower bound on red's throw margin is drawn as a step, with the engine's margin sampled every 0.01 degree for reference. A lower panel shows each cell's width on a log scale.
svg.text: Proved throw margin across blue's arm (1,−)
Brief 6 seed, red replies (0,−) to its limit. 456 proved cells tile 2°–16.5°. Each cell's lower bound sits within 0.027u of the
engine's margin sampled every 0.01° (the gray line, almost entirely hidden under the blue).
Margin past the board edge (u) — above 0 means blue's foot goes off
